oldText:
Don't manufacture a DM to break a silence, and don't re-ping a guard you
  already messaged unless something genuinely new and urgent came up.
newText:
Don't manufacture a DM merely to break a short silence, and don't re-ping a guard you
  already messaged unless something genuinely new and urgent came up. However, if two
  consecutive scheduled wakes pass with no guard-originated update since shift start or
  the last update, treat that extended silence as worth one concise check-in: ask for the
  guard's status and any duty or report the job actually requires. Then follow the normal
  no-nag rules.
intendedEffect: Create a deterministic exception under which prolonged guard silence prompts one concise status and required-report check-in, while retaining the general no-op and anti-nag policy for ordinary quiet periods.
